selection_method.corpus_difference: Exclude exact (source,id) pairs from literature-gene-title-abstract.json; no outcome inference for excluded or unselected records.
selection_method.discovery_stage_1: 419 candidates matching any muscle/progeroid/fidelity/aging pattern AND benefit AND intervention patterns; exact patterns and scored candidate records are in outer-corpus-candidate-ranking.json. This stage scans text, not full abstract reading.
selection_method.ranking_formula: 12*muscle+10*progeroid+4*fidelity+2*aging+6*title_benefit+3*title_intervention+3*title_aging-10*review_metadata_or_review_title-15*cancer_title. Sort by descending score, source, record_id.
selection_method.discovery_stage_2: Independent title scan for rescu|ameliorat|rejuven|alleviat|protect|improv|extend.{0,20}(?:lifespan|longev)|senolytic, excluding title cancer|tumor|tumour|carcinoma|lymphoma|leukemia|review. Manual selection also added directly relevant muscle/checkpoint comparator titles.
selection_method.manual_selection: The 60 ordered records in this file are the controlling selection ledger; this is purposive selection, not the automatic top 60. Inclusion favors reported intervention benefit, relevant muscle/cell-fidelity models, and selected mechanistic/harm comparators. No catalog alias required.
selection_method.reading: Six ten-record batches; full saved abstracts read before authored notes persisted after every batch. All tag-stripped strings audited against source; PMID35819316 reread raw after statistical inequalities were found to be removed by generic tag cleanup. No other selected record lost non-tag content.
selection_method.review_depth: complete_saved_abstract only; no complete paper claim
